Hi there,




When a basic traffic question turns into report configuration, “simpler” only matters if the smaller view still contains the signals you use.




Fathom Analytics is website analytics software built around one single-page dashboard. It shows live and total visitors, pageviews, top pages, referrers, countries, devices, browsers, events and UTM campaigns.




You can add a filter to drill into a campaign, country or single page in one click. That makes the tradeoff visible: a focused set of signals, not a claim to reproduce every GA4 report.




The clickable live demo lets you inspect the dashboard without installing a script or creating an account. Check the referrer and UTM campaign views, then decide whether the scope fits the traffic questions you actually ask.


View a live demo →


- Fathom Analytics
